title: Biomes
body:
Biomes have been talked about for a while but never properly shown in public. There will be 8 in total, and not all of them are finished yet. Here are the ones that are done:

**Plains**
Standard Alpha terrain generation and look. There's not much special about this biome.

![image: Biomes](media/1416910257849892965.png)

**Desert**
Similar to the vanilla Minecraft desert, with cacti and a lot of sand, plus new dead trees and tumbleweeds.

![image: Biomes](media/1416910727436046406.png)

**Autumnal Forest**
A dense forest that is in perpetual autumn, complete with tree stumps and piles of fallen leaves.

![image: Biomes](media/1416911216110211172.png)

**Bog**
Living here is a bit of a challenge thanks to poison ivy and leeches, but it's worth it for the mud that lets you petrify logs into coal.

![image: Biomes](media/1416911661184319670.png)

**Tundra**
Very much inspired by Alpha's old snow world feature: pine trees, a lot of snow, a surplus of gravel, and any water here freezes over.

![image: Biomes](media/1416912131135373364.png)

**Badlands**
The craziest generation of the bunch. A myriad of blocks generate here, including terracotta and silt.

![image: Biomes](media/1416912578797502645.png)

These are all the biomes that have been fully implemented so far. Tropics and Mountains are still planned, if their generation can be made to work.

![image: Biomes](media/1439465945931448461.png)
